messages.content: Hey, I just got out of a strategy meeting with Boss Zhang. Honestly, I'm feeling pretty stressed about the timeline for the Double Eleven sale.
I get it, the timeline is super tight, especially since prep started two weeks earlier this year. What happened in the meeting to stress you out?

Well, Boss Zhang joked that his wife always spends too much money during the Double Eleven sale, which led to a whole discussion on user engagement. So, he actually made the final decision to reinstate a simplified gamification feature for the Double Eleven sale! I know he canceled it back in July, but now it's back on.
Wow, quite the plot twist! Yes, he officially canceled it on July 18th. A simplified version sounds manageable, but it definitely adds to your plate. When are you kicking this off?

We just discussed the schedule for the upcoming kickoff meeting for the Double Eleven sale. We'll need to align with Wanghao's engineering team ASAP so they can factor it into their tech debt and code freeze timelines.
Smart move. Getting Wanghao's team in the loop early is crucial given their strict performance goals. Need me to draft an agenda for that kickoff?
Not yet, I need a break first. I actually promised to buy Boss Zhang a coffee to celebrate the new plan for the Double Eleven sale, so I'm going to head down to the cafe now.
Sounds like a well-deserved break. Go grab that coffee and take a breather. Let me know when you're ready to tackle those kickoff slides!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-11, Boss Zhang made the final decision to reinstate a simplified gamification feature for the Double Eleven sale.

messages.content: Hey, I just got out of the load testing review with Wanghao for the Double Eleven sale.
How did it go? Did the recent optimizations hold up?
Yeah, they did. Wanghao concluded that the checkout service can now safely handle a peak of 18,000 QPS for the Double Eleven sale after the database migration.
That's a great jump from the 15,000 QPS last week! Is he feeling confident now?

Not exactly. He actually expressed deep anxiety about whether the servers would actually survive the Double Eleven sale. We even debated whether the marketing team's strategy for the sale was just too aggressive this year.
Marketing always likes to push the limits. What's the plan to make sure things stay stable?
Well, Wanghao promised to send me the raw logs from the Double Eleven sale load test so I can review them. I also scheduled a follow-up sync for the Double Eleven sale on Thursday at 3:00 PM.
Sounds like a solid plan. I'll keep the Thursday 3:00 PM sync in mind. Let me know when you get those logs!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-12, Wanghao concluded that the checkout service can now safely handle a peak of 18,000 QPS for the Double Eleven sale after the database migration.

messages.content: Hey, I need to set a reminder. Liwei and I were just talking about the new Pixel 9 phone. She mentioned that pre-orders for it open at 8:00 AM next Tuesday.
Got it! I'll set a reminder for next Tuesday morning before 8:00 AM. Are you planning to grab one for her?
Yeah, I made a serious commitment to Liwei that I will pre-order the Pixel 9 phone for her upcoming birthday. I was looking at the specs too, and noted that it has a new Tensor G4 chip.
That’s an awesome birthday gift! I've noted down your commitment to pre-order it. Have you decided which version to get?

I concluded that the base model of the Pixel 9 phone is the most cost-effective. We also discussed how the pink color variant of the Pixel 9 phone looks in the promo videos, and she really likes that one.
Makes sense, the base model is usually the sweet spot, and the pink one looks great. Anything else you need me to remember about this?
Not for the reminder, but honestly, I felt a sudden surge of affection for Liwei when she talked excitedly about the Pixel 9 phone camera features. Seeing her so hyped up was just really cute.
Aww, that's really sweet, Linchen. I'll make sure to remember that moment. Good luck snagging that pre-order next Tuesday!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-13, Linchen made a serious commitment to Liwei that he will pre-order the Pixel 9 phone for her upcoming birthday.
On 2025-08-13, Linchen felt a sudden surge of affection for Liwei when she talked excitedly about the Pixel 9 phone camera features.

messages.content: Hey, I just had lunch with Sister Chen. We were chatting about that Pixel 9 phone I told Liwei I'd pre-order for her birthday.
Oh nice! How did the lunch chat go? Did you pull the trigger on the pre-order?
I did, but honestly, I expressed some intense financial anxiety to Sister Chen today. I saw the actual retail price of the Pixel 9 phone is exactly 6999 RMB, and it just hit me hard.
Oof, 6999 RMB is definitely a big chunk of change, especially right after you just increased your monthly apartment budget by 1000 RMB. What did Sister Chen think about it?

She thinks it's a bit steep. She actually concluded that the battery life of the Pixel 9 isn't much better than the previous generation. But I still promised to show her the phone once it arrives in the mail.
Well, even if the battery is similar, the camera upgrades Liwei was so excited about will make it worth it! Are you going to get any accessories for it?
Yeah, Sister Chen and I scheduled a time to go to the electronics mall together to look at cases for the Pixel 9 phone. Hopefully I can find a decent deal on a case so I don't spend too much more!
Sounds like a solid plan! Try not to stress too much about the money—Liwei is going to be absolutely thrilled with the gift.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-14, Linchen expressed intense financial anxiety to Sister Chen after seeing the actual retail price of the Pixel 9 phone.

messages.content: Hey, I'm just finishing up at the gym with Jiange in the locker room. I've got to tell you, I am deeply exhausted from this endless apartment hunting. Can you update my calendar?
You've definitely been putting in the hours looking for a place! What do you need me to update on your calendar?

I had to reschedule the downtown loft viewing for the apartment hunting. Move it to 4:00 PM on Sunday instead of Saturday. Jiange was just telling me that based on his own apartment hunting experience, he concluded the average rent in the downtown area is 8000 RMB.
Got it, I've moved the downtown loft viewing to Sunday at 4:00 PM. 8000 RMB is definitely a benchmark to keep in mind for that area.

Yeah, it's wild. Jiange and I were just joking about the terrible interior design choices we've seen during the apartment hunting. Who puts carpet in a bathroom? Anyway, I promised to invite Jiange over for beers once the apartment hunting is finally over.
Carpet in the bathroom is a crime against humanity. I'll make sure to remind you to host those celebratory beers with Jiange once you finally sign a lease. Anything else you need me to log?
No, that's it for now. I'm going to grab a shower and head out. Thanks!
Have a good shower and a relaxing Friday night, Linchen. Let me know if you need anything later.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-15, Linchen rescheduled the downtown loft viewing for the apartment hunting to 4:00 PM on Sunday instead of Saturday.

messages.content: Hey, I just finished my weekly phone catch-up with Mom. We mostly talked about the apartment hunting, and I'm honestly a bit stressed now.
Ah, the classic family catch-up. What's stressing you out about the apartment hunt?

Well, I felt a wave of irritation when Mom criticized my budget for the apartment hunting. She did her own research and concluded that high-rise buildings are 30% more expensive, so she thinks I'm aiming too high.
Moms and their research! It can be tough when they weigh in on your finances. Did you at least get to talk about the places you've actually looked at?

Yeah, we discussed the square footage numbers of the places I saw during the apartment hunting. Anyway, to calm her down, I promised Mom I would strictly check the daytime street noise levels during the apartment hunting this weekend.
That's a good compromise, and definitely something worth checking anyway. When are you following up with her?
I scheduled a video call with Mom for Sunday evening to discuss the apartment hunting results. Hopefully, I'll have a quiet, reasonably-priced place to show her.
Fingers crossed for a great find! I'll make sure you don't forget the noise check and your Sunday call with her.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-15, Linchen promised Mom he would strictly check the daytime street noise levels during the apartment hunting this weekend.

messages.content: Hey, I'm just texting Jiange about my dentist appointment today. I told him I had this intense fear about the drilling during the visit. It was rough.
Ouch, the drill is never fun. Did everything go okay despite the nerves?
Yeah, I survived. Though Jiange concluded that the clinic I used charges 20% more than average. Still, the staff was great, so I promised to give Jiange the contact info for the hygienist.
A good hygienist is definitely worth it, even with the premium! Is he thinking of switching dentists?

Maybe. Mostly we just complained about the terrible waiting room music at the dentist appointment. Anyway, I informed Jiange that I scheduled a follow-up procedure from this appointment for next Thursday at 6:00 PM, so I might miss our usual gym time.
Got it. I'll make sure your calendar is updated for the follow-up next Thursday at 6:00 PM. Let's hope they change their playlist by then!
Thanks. Yeah, hopefully no more drilling and better tunes. I'll catch you later.
Sounds good, Linchen. Have a great rest of your Saturday!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-16, Linchen informed Jiange that he scheduled a follow-up procedure from the dentist appointment for next Thursday at 6:00 PM.

messages.content: Hey, I just finished my update call with Mom. I felt a huge sense of relief talking to her after surviving the dentist appointment today.
I bet! The dentist is never fun. Did everything go okay?
Yeah, it wasn't too bad. Mom noted that the total out-of-pocket cost for the dentist appointment was 450 RMB, which she thought was pretty reasonable.
That's definitely not bad for dental work. Are you all done, or do you have to go back?

I mentioned to her that I need to go back at 6:00 PM next week for a follow-up because of the dentist appointment today. Oh, and I promised Mom I would buy a water flosser immediately following the dentist appointment, so I need to go do that.
Got it, I can remind you to order that water flosser later if you want. Did the dentist give you any other instructions?
Not really, but Mom and I discussed the specific brand of toothpaste the doctor recommended during the dentist appointment. I'll probably just order it online with the flosser.
Sounds like a solid plan. Your teeth are going to be in great shape! Let me know if you need help finding either of those online.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-16, Linchen promised Mom he would buy a water flosser immediately following the dentist appointment.

messages.content: Hey, I need to vent and get my notes straight. I just got out of an emergency weekend budget review with Boss Zhang for the Double Eleven sale. I felt a sharp pang of frustration when he told me the marketing budget was getting cut.
Ouch, Sunday budget cuts are the worst. I know you've been working hard on this. What exactly went down?

Well, we debated for a while whether the competitors were also scaling back their ad spend for the Double Eleven sale. But ultimately, Boss Zhang made the final decision to freeze all non-essential marketing spend for the Double Eleven sale to allocate more funds to server stability.
Given Wanghao's recent pushes to scale the database and checkout services, the pivot to server stability makes sense, even if it's frustrating. How is the rest of the team finding out?
Boss Zhang scheduled a mandatory all-hands on Monday at 9:00 AM to announce the changes for the Double Eleven sale. It's going to be a tense meeting.
I bet. Do you have a lot of prep work to do before that 9:00 AM meeting?
Yeah, unfortunately. I promised to update the vendor contracts to reflect the new policy for the Double Eleven sale. I better go brew some coffee and get started.
Grab that coffee! Let me know if you need help drafting any emails to the vendors once you've updated the contracts. You've got this.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-17, Boss Zhang made the final decision to freeze all non-essential marketing spend for the Double Eleven sale to allocate more funds to server stability.

conversations.topic: Evening chat after a long day

messages.content: Hey! I just got off the phone with Sister Chen. I am feeling such overwhelming relief and joy right now. We finally submitted a lease application today to wrap up this exhausting apartment hunting!
That is amazing news! I know how stressed you've been about finding a place. Did you end up going with the downtown loft you saw this afternoon?
Yeah, it was perfect! Sister Chen helped me crunch the numbers, and she concluded that the deposit for the new place is exactly 1.5 times the monthly rent. It fits right into the budget.
That's a solid deal, especially after increasing your budget recently. Are you signing the paperwork right away?
Almost. We scheduled a quick coffee for Monday morning to review the lease terms together first. The leasing agent we met, Mr. Wang, emailed the draft over a few hours ago.
Smart move. A fresh pair of eyes over coffee will make sure there are no hidden surprises in the contract. Sister Chen has been a lifesaver through all this.
She really has. I already promised to invite Sister Chen to the housewarming party to celebrate the end of the apartment hunting. I'm just so glad this chapter is closing.
She definitely earned that VIP invite! Enjoy the rest of your Sunday evening, Linchen. You deserve to relax after finally getting this sorted.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-17, Linchen expressed overwhelming relief and joy to Sister Chen after finally submitting a lease application during the apartment hunting.
